agent: agent
description: Implement a feature using Urban Spoon's documented contracts and validation workflow.
---

Read `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, the relevant `.github/instructions/` files, and the relevant product, API, database, security, UI, and testing documents. Inspect existing code before editing.

Implement the smallest coherent vertical slice, including UI, backend, database, API, security, and tests as applicable. Use migrations for schema changes, preserve compatibility, keep secrets out of source control, and update contracts when behavior changes.

Run focused tests first, then relevant regression, lint, typecheck, and build commands. Report files, API/data changes, commands, actual results, risks, and documentation updates.
